caption_txt.title: Worried About the Student Visa Changes? Come In and Ask — 6–16 October
body: With the recent student visa changes, many of you may be feeling worried — especially if your student visa is expiring soon.

From 6 to 16 October, Monday to Friday between 1 and 2 PM, come and speak with us in person at our Sydney and Parramatta offices. Rahul Dhanda, Director & Registered Migration Agent at PFEC Global Parramatta (MARN 2418640), and our team will walk you through how these changes may affect you, what you should do next, and what options may currently be available to you.
bullets: 📍 PFEC Global Sydney — Ste 402, Level 4/447 Kent St, Sydney NSW 2000
📍 PFEC Global Parramatta — Ground Floor, 1/21 George Street, Parramatta NSW 2150
💬 How the changes affect you · your next steps · your current options
caption_txt.urgency: Don't wait until it's too late — come in, ask your questions and get clarity.
